title: Duel Decks: Heroes vs. Monsters: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: A blazing sun that never sets.
He has nothing left but his resentment.
"It is hope, hooved and winged." —Cymede, queen of Akros
His prowess gives the guildless hope that they can hold out against tyranny.
"Once more into Devil's Breach, soldiers. I want another devil tail for my collection."
The tips of her bolts are blunt, but her aim is deadly sharp.
"In memories, we can find our deepest reserves of strength."
Confront her, and feel the hooves of her steed. Ignore her, and feel the sting of her arrow.
Akros's greatest heroes are also its royalty.
The Dimir agents watched from the shadows. "Eight hours, and I've yet to see him blink," Nefara hissed. "I suggest we find another way in."
Entire platoons have mysteriously vanished from battle, leaving enemy weapons to slice through empty air.
She crushes darkness beneath her charger's hooves.
"A great siege is a banquet to him; a long and terrible battle, the most exquisite delicacy." —*The Seer's Parables*
In times when freedom seems lost, great souls arise to reclaim it.
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now." —Alovnek, Boros guildmage
What self-indulgence tears down, discipline builds up again.
"My course is before me. There is nothing behind me."
Sometimes the greatest strength is the strength of conviction.
"What cannot be destroyed will be bound." —Oath of Avacyn
"My faith is stronger than fang, claw, or mindless hunger."
"Boom! Boom! Boots the size of oxcarts, then an axe like a falling sun. Elves scattered. Trees scattered. Even the hills ran for the hills!" —*Clachan Tales*
Though the old holy wards and roadside shrines have begun to fail, faith in Avacyn still holds true power.
"I am the rock of the polis. Death only strengthens me."
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence." —Oracle *en*-Vec
Enter with merciful hearts. Exit with battle cries.
"Wood is wasted in the dirt." —Orcish proverb
Even dragons fear its silken strands.
In a withered world, the scent of healthy prey is enough to drive a predator to frenzy.
"Any festival you can walk away from wasn't worth attending in the first place."
"Only the decadent think magic should be pristine and without cost."
It's no coincidence that the oldest trolls are also the angriest.
The best way to calm a rampaging ceratok is to wait until it dies of natural causes.
Some of the eleven minotaur clans of Mirtiin are expert crafters and learned philosophers. Others just like to hit stuff.
The snap of sinew. The crunch of bone. A cry for mercy. These are the music of the Gruul.
"He bears the marks of ages upon his skin, memories of dreams long dead and best left buried." —*The Seer's Parables*
It speaks no commands but is always obeyed.
"The sky isn't falling—it's being thrown at us!" —Otak, Tin Street shopkeep
The viashino had learned how to operate the rig through trial and error—mostly error.
"You don't find many old werewolf hunters." —Paulin, trapper of Somberwald
"Who'd want to ignite things one at a time?" —Chandra Nalaar
While the root remains, the tree yet lives.
Elmut had slaughtered vampires, slain werewolves, and destroyed hordes of zombies. Sadly, he never got over his fear of spiders.
"Stoke a fire hot enough and you'll never run out of things to burn." —Xenagos, the Reveler
A single drop turns skin to scale and fist to claw.
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them." —Euphemia, Nexus watcher
Yavimaya lights the quickest path to battle.
"This palace will be our fire-spit, and roasted prince our victory meal. Send in the torch-pigs!" —Ghut Rak, Gruul guildmage
